items.question: What is the average ESR1 expression in primary-tumor samples of ER-negative patients, rounded to 2 decimals?

attempts.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(gene_expression.log2_expr), 2) AS avg_esr1_expr
FROM gene_expression
JOIN rna_samples ON gene_expression.sample_id = rna_samples.sample_id
JOIN clinical ON gene_expression.patient_id = clinical.patient_id
WHERE gene_expression.gene_symbol = 'ESR1'
  AND rna_samples.sample_type_code = '01'
  AND clinical.er_status = 'Negative'

items.final_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(gene_expression.log2_expr), 2) AS avg_esr1_expr
FROM gene_expression
JOIN rna_samples ON gene_expression.sample_id = rna_samples.sample_id
JOIN clinical ON gene_expression.patient_id = clinical.patient_id
WHERE gene_expression.gene_symbol = 'ESR1'
  AND rna_samples.sample_type_code = '01'
  AND clinical.er_status = 'Negative'
items.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.log2_expr), 2) FROM gene_expression g JOIN rna_samples s ON s.sample_id = g.sample_id JOIN clinical c ON c.patient_id = g.patient_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' AND s.sample_type_code = '01' AND c.er_status = 'Negative'
